question: Nagananda, a Sanskrit play which tells the popular story of Vidyadhar King Jimutavahana's self-sacrifice to save the Nagas, is attributed to emperor ______
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harsha__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagananda is a Sanskrit play attributed to emperor Harsha.**
 
• Nagananda is among the most acclaimed Sanskrit dramas.
 
• **It tells the story of Vidyadhar King Jimutavahana's self-sacrifice to save the Nagas.**
 
• The **unique characteristic** of this drama is the** invocation to Buddha in the Nandi verse.**
 
• The play depicts the story of **how prince Jimutavahana gives up his own body** to stop a sacrifice of a Naga prince **to the divine Garuda.**
 
• The play was** first introduced in January 2008 at Panaji, Goa in Marathi by Prabhakar Sanskritic Sanstha.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Bindusara**

 
 
• ​**Bindusara, also known as Amitrochates was the second Mauryan emperor of India.**
 
• He was the** son of the dynasty's founder Chandragupta** and the father of its most famous ruler Ashoka.
 
 
 
• **Ashoka**
 
 
• Ashoka the Great, was an** Indian emperor of the Maurya Empire, son of Bindusara.**
 
• He **conquered almost all of the Indian subcontinent** from 268 to 232 BCE.
 
• Ashoka **promoted the spread of Buddhism** across ancient Asia.
 
 
 
• **Chandra Gupta I**
 
 
• **​Chandragupta, I was a king of the Gupta Empire, who ruled northern and central India.**
 
• His** title Maharajadhiraja **suggests that he was the first emperor of the dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Harsha**
 
 
• **​Harsha, also spelled Harṣa, also called Harshavardhana, was the ruler of a large empire in northern India from 606 to 647 CE.**
 
• He was a Buddhist convert in the Hindu era.
 
• **He was a member of the Vardhana dynasty and was the son of Prabhakaravardhana.**
